summary: Release candidate 0.4.0 is ready as a local source handoff for the LLM bridge feature. The Python package builds reproducibly with packaged web assets, the source tree contains the Bun llm_bridge service, the README/web guide/changelog document startup and rollback, and release readiness plus secret scan pass.
build_artifacts: appforge/resources/web/index.html plus appforge/resources/web/assets/index-Bto0ykgx.js and index-C_67LZJ9.css from the production frontend build
llm_bridge/ source service with bun.lock, vendored @opencode-ai/llm provider engine, TypeScript sources, and Bun regression test
The final source archive is produced by the following handoff stage's archive_workspace gate, not by this release stage
install_and_run: Frontend assets are already built into appforge/resources/web; rebuild with npm --prefix frontend run build after UI changes
Bridge setup from source: cd llm_bridge && bun install && bun run start
Web app with bridge driver: APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge .venv/bin/appforge web
Provider setup: open Provider Settings in the web UI, save a provider key or rely on provider environment variables, choose a model, test the provider, and activate it

Wheel smoke: uv pip install --no-deps --target /private/tmp/appforge-v4-release-install-20260627-1754 dist/openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl succeeded; PYTHONPATH import check reported appforge version 0.4.0, package metadata version 0.4.0, and packaged web index present
configuration: APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge enables the local bridge driver; aliases llm_bridge and llm are also accepted by backend driver creation.
APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL controls the FastAPI-to-bridge URL and defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8788.
APPFORGE_LLM_PROVIDER can optionally override the active provider for the driver; APPFORGE_MODEL can override the model.
Bridge process defaults: APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_HOST=127.0.0.1 and APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_PORT=8788.
Bridge config defaults to ~/.appforge/llm/providers.json unless APPFORGE_LLM_CONFIG_DIR or APPFORGE_LLM_CONFIG is set.

Provider keys may be stored through the UI or supplied through provider-specific environment variables such as OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, and XAI_API_KEY.
migrations: Existing AppForge jobs and checkpoints remain compatible; APPFORGE_DRIVER defaults still preserve auto, codex, claude, and generic behavior.
Users adopting llm-bridge need a new local bridge config file only when they save provider settings through the UI.

release_checks.evidence: env PATH=.venv/bin:... .venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run run_build --project . --input '{}' returned success and built dist/openappforge-0.4.0.tar.gz plus dist/openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl.
uv pip install --no-deps --target /private/tmp/appforge-v4-release-install-20260627-1754 dist/openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl succeeded; PYTHONPATH import check printed 0.4.0, 0.4.0, True.
.venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run secret_scan --project . --input '{}' returned passed=true with findings=[].
release_readiness returned passed=true with source_present, readme, gitignore, verification_artifact, and optional security_artifact all passing.
artifact_inventory found dist/, README.md, LICENSE, and CHANGELOG.md; detected stack is Python/FastAPI with pyproject.toml.
Verification stage ran npm run build in frontend/ and produced appforge/resources/web assets served by the Python package.
Verification/security stages ran bun run typecheck and bun run test in llm_bridge/; the regression covers no raw API-key echo and no wildcard CORS.
Verification stage ran .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q with 23 passing tests and one existing Starlette TestClient deprecation warning.

known_issues: Live provider connectivity was not verified because no user API credentials were supplied; provider test/generate behavior is exercised structurally but not against real vendor APIs.
The online dependency audit remains skipped because AppForge network downloads are disabled for this project; this is documented in the security report.

The Python wheel contains the FastAPI bridge proxy and packaged web UI, but the Bun llm_bridge service is a source-tree component. Use the source checkout/source archive or an already-running bridge for APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge.
The llm-bridge driver is single-shot per stage and does not perform CLI-agent file editing. Fully agentic file-editing stages should use Codex, Claude Code, or a generic command driver.
Setuptools emits deprecation warnings for the existing project.license table and license classifier metadata; builds still pass, but metadata should be modernized before 2027-Feb-18.
rollback: Runtime rollback: set APPFORGE_DRIVER back to auto, codex, claude, or generic, and stop the llm_bridge Bun process.
Provider rollback: delete provider settings through the web UI or remove the local bridge config file at APPFORGE_LLM_CONFIG / ~/.appforge/llm/providers.json.
Source rollback: revert the LLM bridge feature files and restore the previous appforge/resources/web hashed assets from version control.
Package rollback: keep using the previous dist/openappforge-0.4.0 artifacts or source archive from before this feature; no deployment or publication occurred in this stage.
